sources.bamboo_parts.png: Use the supplied bamboo character as the identity reference. Produce a clean transparent 2-by-2 SPRITE PARTS ATLAS with FOUR separate isolated components, one centered within each equal quadrant, no touching quadrant borders, no text labels or grid. TOP LEFT: only the expressive bamboo cannon HEAD facing right, hollow round muzzle, determined eyes, a SHORT neck socket underneath; no stalk or root leaves. TOP RIGHT: only a vertical gently curved jade bamboo STALK of two segments, cyan seam, generous thick connecting ends for overlap; no head or eyes. BOTTOM LEFT: only a low wide cluster of root LEAVES in the original dark green style, no stalk or head. BOTTOM RIGHT: only one long horizontal bamboo spear projectile pointing RIGHT, sharpened pale bamboo tip, 2 jade nodes, tiny cyan liquid streak along shaft; no face. Preserve thick dark ink outlines and cel shaded classic casual game style. Entire atlas genuinely transparent background; all four parts complete and isolated, with wide padding inside their quadrant. This is for assembling a jointed game animation, not four whole characters.

Hand-painted classic casual tower-defense game art with strong dark outlines and simple chunky cel shading, readable at 80 pixels. NO zombie, NO human, NO hands, no feet, no ground, no text, no gauges with text, no background. Equipment alone, full silhouette visible, modest transparent margin. Compact arrangement that can sit behind zombie shoulders without covering face.
